capabilities: Render a Harada Method chart from a 'harada' code block
Break one goal into 8 plans and 64 actions
Define chart content with two-space indentation
disambiguation: It does not draw general diagrams or images; it renders only the Harada Method goal chart from a code block.
extras: A TODO section lists unfinished work: handling non-conforming text, more indentation characters, and options. Installation can also be done manually by copying files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw the Harada Method (Mandara chart) grid for breaking a goal into plans and actions.
summary: Plugin that renders Harada Method goal charts (1 goal, 8 plans, 64 actions) from a 'harada' code block in notes.
